content:
The iframe tactic is now merged :tada: You can now use the iframe tactic and the $ specialization and cases patterns to automatically frame hypotheses. Let me know if you run into any issues with the tactic.

Implementing the tactic also required being more principled about how input and output parameters are handled by the proof mode. See the comment here about the new moding discipline enforced by the proof mode synthesis and let me know if there are any questions.
Amazing! This is going to help clean up so many proofs :)
